selection_rule: Preserve original100; add first400 qualifying equities in descending IWB holding market value, tie ticker. No strategy returns used.
source_selection_bias: Current survivor/provider-available sample. November2026 membership and endpoint liquidity are future information relative to2022-2025. Not point-in-time universe.
reproduction: Use the committed500-member list; never fetch latest holdings to silently replace members on reruns. Raw holdings, source market data and per-candidate outcomes remain outsideGit.
